center.title: AI × human intelligence
center.text: The thread through everything I care about: how machines and people think, learn, model the world, and work together.

topics.name: Maps of consciousness
topics.what: Models that lay out levels or states of consciousness as a map, such as David Hawkins' scale from fear up to peace. They're frameworks for thinking, not settled science.
topics.link: Where does AI sit on a map built for human minds? It's a good lens for what models can and can't experience, as long as it's presented as a model, not proof.
topics.video: Where Would AI Sit on a Map of Consciousness? (Thought Experiment)

topics.name: Lacan
topics.what: Jacques Lacan's psychoanalysis: the unconscious is structured like a language, and experience runs through three registers, the Real, the Symbolic and the Imaginary.
topics.link: A large language model is pure Symbolic order: language with no body and no Real. Lacan gives an unusual, sharp way to explain why LLMs are fluent but not grounded.
topics.video: Lacan Predicted LLMs? Language Without a Body, Explained

topics.name: UML
topics.what: The Unified Modeling Language: class, sequence and activity diagrams for designing systems before building them.
topics.link: Diagrams are specs. A Delivery Pilot writes the flight plan, and a sequence diagram is a flight plan an AI agent can follow.
topics.video: UML Is Back: Diagrams as Specs for AI Coding Agents

topics.name: Enterprise patterns
topics.what: Enterprise application and integration patterns (Fowler; Hohpe & Woolf): repositories, message channels, routers, sagas. The proven shapes of business software.
topics.link: Multi-agent systems are integration patterns with an LLM inside. And your migration contracts are where these patterns earn money.
topics.video: Your Multi-Agent System Is Just Enterprise Integration Patterns

topics.name: Space & physics
topics.what: Human spaceflight and the physics behind it: missions, mission control, and the long-range dream of reaching another star.
topics.link: The pilot metaphor is literal here: mission control, flight plans and instruments. Space missions are the original high-stakes delivery.
topics.video: What Would It Take to Reach Another Star? (Physics + AI)

topics.name: Real-time strategy games
topics.what: Games like Command & Conquer: build a base, gather resources, command units, scout through the fog of war.
topics.link: Running AI agents is an RTS. You command units (agents), manage resources (tokens and cost), and scout the unknown. It's the Delivery Pilot job as a game.
topics.video: Running AI Agents Is a Real-Time Strategy Game

rule: 🎯 Every interest becomes content only through the Delivery Pilot lens. Deep topics (Lacan, consciousness) need a practical or data-backed payoff, or they'll behave like mindset Shorts.
